newsitem.title: UK: Guardian shares weaken after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Guardian shares weaken after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in British insurance group Guardian Royal Exchange Plc nudged lower in pre-market trade on Wednesday after first-half results came in at the low end of analyst forecasts.
"The results just look a bit disappointing," said one senior trader. The stock was quoted down 4-1/2p at 290-1/2 by 0716 GMT in thin volume of 36,000 shares.

Guardian said trading profit for the first six months of the year fell to 105 million stg from 137 million a year before, compared with analyst forecasts mostly in a range between 110 million stg and 130 million.

The company said sterling strength had wiped 9.5 million stg off trading profits but said it was achieving premium rate increases in the private motor market sector. It said it did not see any rapid changes to competitive pressures in other major market sectors.
